arms.A: G1 configuration (C* control, k = 11,541.56, cold, rel 1e-4, rho_pf 300 adaptive, cap 90, budget 5.0e6, remedy (h), H3) with Candidate 4 reverted: params.slacks.flexibility.day_balance = False on every network (restores pe.inequality(-SMALL_TOLERANCE, p_up - p_down, SMALL_TOLERANCE) and removes slack_flex_*_balance). Recovery policy G1-equivalent: case33_1 recovery disabled, tier 2 off.
arms.B: Run only if A fails the criterion: G1 configuration with Candidate 1 re-wired (shared-ESS power-factor rows restored), Candidate 4 as in G1, same G1-equivalent recovery policy.

criterion.attribution_A: Candidate 4 is the cause iff A recovers BOTH EFC (all nodes) and recourse; record that the old numbers carried a spurious flexible-energy source
criterion.attribution_B: Candidate 1 is the cause iff B recovers BOTH; if neither, attribution is unresolved within the two-run budget
criterion.efc_all: EFC recovered iff recovered on all three nodes 5, 7, 9
criterion.efc_per_node: recovered on node n iff |EFC_arm(n) - EFC_old(n)| <= 0.10 * |EFC_G1(n) - EFC_old(n)| (arm closes >= 90% of the G1-vs-old year-1 EFC/day gap)
criterion.partial: report per-node gap closure fraction 1 - |EFC_arm - EFC_old| / |EFC_G1 - EFC_old| and recourse difference/bar regardless of verdict
criterion.recourse: recovered iff |recourse_arm - old_recourse| <= old_terminal_step + arm_terminal_step (rule nine)
criterion.validity: criterion applies only if the arm converged within the cap and its rule-ten ratio (terminal step / tolerance) < 1; otherwise verdict INDETERMINATE

not_permitted: tuning any tolerance, rho, cap or budget
changing the criterion after any ablation result is seen
